input: app.use('/support/logs', serveIndexMiddleware, serveIndex('logs', { icons: true, view: 'details' })) // vuln-code-snippet vuln-line accessLogDisclosureChallenge

context.guidance: Require authentication on every route that returns Personal Data, and check on each request that the authenticated Data Principal owns the record or holds a role authorised for it. Do not let an identifier supplied in the path or body decide ownership. Apply the check to every method on the route, because Rule 6(1)(b) requires access to the resources holding Personal Data to be controlled.

value.fix: Remove the public exposure of the logs directory. Delete the `app.use('/support/logs', serveIndexMiddleware, serveIndex('logs', ...))` mount, or put it behind authentication and an admin-role check on every method. Do not serve the logs directory from the web root at all: move the logs outside the static path and keep log files out of any express.static mount. If an authorised support view is still needed, add a requireAuth middleware and a requireRole('support-admin') check before any serveIndex or static handler, and do not let path or body identifiers choose which log is returned. Resolve the log directory with path.resolve against a fixed absolute path, not the process cwd. Redact personal data from log files before storage, and set retention limits. Add tests that send unauthenticated and under-privileged GET, HEAD, and POST requests to /support/logs and confirm they receive 401 or 403 and no directory listing or file contents.
